subject: FILE-CONTROL entry, ASSIGN clause (TO phrase meaning and rules)
notes: kb/Work PB829 (wave 48 W). A.1 item 71 - FILE-CONTROL entry, ASSIGN clause (TO phrase meaning and rules), 12.4.5.2 SR5 and SR6 (cite.py --check OK for both). Determination, following GnuCOBOL per CLAUDE.md rule 1: the TO phrase is one operand naming the physical file, or a device class DISK or PRINTER followed by one operand naming it (the class selects nothing further - both are host files); any other list is COBOL2256. An operand's value or spelling maps to a host path by CobolFile.ResolveHostPath. SR6: TO alone, USING alone and both together are all allowed (GR3 b) lets the content win - item 10).
